title: P2LRN CASE Alignment Profile
description: Binds P2LRN objectives, alignments and rubrics to stable CASE 1.1 identifiers without copying a whole competency service into Core.
rules: P2LRN SHOULD reference stable CASE identifiers when the source provides them.
CASE documents MAY be preserved as resources when offline portability is required.
A Core validator MUST NOT dereference CASE URLs during package validation.
